name: Cederberg
blurb: Travelers in the Cederberg mountains of South Africa highlight dramatic hiking landscapes like the Wolfberg Cracks and Maltese Cross, alongside ancient rock art and spring flower viewings. Recent regional reports note a significant wildfire that burned tens of thousands of hectares of mountain wilderness.

positive: Dramatic hiking landscapes and mountain scenery
Rich concentration of ancient rock art and history
Popular destination for road trips and winter/spring visits
negative: Severe wildfires burning large areas of mountain wilderness

quotes.text:
Two months ago, a wildfire tore through central Cederberg, burning an estimated 53,000 hectares of mountain wilderness.
